ja: 私のミスのせいで、チーム全員に週末出勤させることになってしまって、本当に申し訳ない。
en: I'm truly sorry that my mistake made the whole team come in on the weekend.
alternatives: I'm really sorry my mistake forced the whole team to work over the weekend.
I'm so sorry. Because of my mistake, the whole team had to come in on the weekend.
point: make + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: 引っ越しを手伝ってくれてありがとう。本当に困っていたんだ。
en: Thanks for helping me move. I was really struggling.
alternatives: Thank you for helping me move. I was really having a hard time.
Thanks for your help with the move. I was really struggling.
point: 「困っていた」は過去進行形 was struggling で表せる

ja: ミスしてすみません。次はダブルチェックします。
en: Sorry for the mistake. I'll double-check next time.
alternatives: I'm sorry about the mistake. I will double-check next time.
Sorry about the mistake. I'll double-check it next time.
point: その場で決めた約束は will。the mistake の冠詞も忘れずに

ja: 今回ご迷惑をおかけしたのは、チームのミスではなく、私が数字の確認を怠ったせいです。申し訳ありません。
en: It was my failure to check the figures, not a mistake by the team, that caused this inconvenience. I sincerely apologize.
alternatives: What caused this inconvenience was my failure to check the figures, not a mistake by the team. I sincerely apologize.
It was my failure to check the numbers, not the team's mistake, that caused this trouble. I sincerely apologize.
point: It was A, not B, that で「B ではなく A が」を強調

ja: 新人の田中くんがミスに気づいてなかったら、私たち、お客さんに間違った見積もりを送ってたよ。ちゃんとお礼言わなきゃ。
en: If our new hire Tanaka hadn't spotted the mistake, we'd have sent the client the wrong quote. We should thank him properly.
alternatives: If Tanaka, our new hire, hadn't caught the mistake, we'd have sent the client the wrong quote. We should really thank him.
We'd have sent the client the wrong quote if our new guy Tanaka hadn't noticed the mistake. We need to thank him properly.
point: 過去の事実の裏は If S had done, S would have done

ja: さっき君が車で送ってくれなかったら、僕は今ごろまだ駅で待ってたよ。ほんとにありがとう！
en: If you hadn't driven me here, I'd still be waiting at the station right now. Thanks so much!
alternatives: If you hadn't given me a ride, I'd still be waiting at the station right now. Thank you so much!
Thanks so much! If you hadn't driven me, I'd still be stuck waiting at the station now.
point: 過去の条件＋今の結果は If I had done, I'd be doing

ja: あの朝あなたが車で送ってくれなかったら、私は面接に間に合わなかったと思います。本当にありがとうございました。
en: If you hadn't given me a ride that morning, I don't think I'd have made it to the interview. Thank you so much.
alternatives: I don't think I would have made it to the interview if you hadn't driven me that morning. Thank you so much.
If you hadn't driven me that morning, I probably wouldn't have gotten to the interview in time. I really appreciate it.
point: 過去の仮定は had 過去分詞、帰結は would have 過去分詞

ja: 先日お貸しいただいた資料を、まだお返ししていなくて申し訳ありません。
en: I'm sorry I still haven't returned the documents that you lent me the other day.
alternatives: I'm sorry I haven't returned the materials you lent me the other day yet.
I apologize that I still haven't returned the documents you lent me the other day.
point: 「まだ〜していない」は still haven't returned
